description: SSRF-safe spot-check of a public URL for an x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED / 402 challenge. Returns reachable, http_status, latency_ms, parsed accepts summary, quoted_price_usd, and optional price_matches_claimed. Never pays the target (probe GET only). 1 free check per client per UTC day (client=vc-mcp for this tool), then $0.25 USDC on Base via x402. Unpaid after free quota: returns payment instructions + free remaining. Forward PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to run a paid check.

claimed_price.description: optional claimed USD price to compare

name: endpoint_spot_check
